evidence: The treehouse is shown as an isolated, clearly identifiable exterior in a three-quarter isometric view.
Dark purple-brown expressive outlines separate the trunk, roofs, platforms, windows, stairs, foliage, and slide.
Rounded roofs, oversized arched windows, broad curved balconies, thick stairs, a massive trunk, and a large spiral slide create a bold, exaggerated shape language.
Gentle cel-like shading and soft highlights give the wood, foliage, stone, fabric, and painted architectural surfaces tactile volume.
The palette is dominated by lavender, lilac, violet, and plum, balanced by warm brown wood, cream walls, glowing yellow windows, and muted green ground cover.
A large tethered crescent ornament, spiral slide, glowing lanterns, crystals, bells, stars, ribbons, and sparkling lights are visibly integrated into the structure.
The silhouette remains recognizable, though numerous railings, hanging ornaments, stairs, roof segments, and foliage clusters create moderately high detail density at small scale.
The rendering has polished architectural complexity and natural proportions rather than character-like or chibi proportions.

hardFindings.evidence: Visible dark expressive outlines frame rounded chunky forms; gentle cel shading and highlights model tactile wood, foliage, stone, and painted surfaces; the palette combines purples with warm brown, cream, yellow, and green; the exterior uses a three-quarter isometric view; and its many ornaments, railings, stairs, windows, and foliage produce moderately high but organized detail density.
hardFindings.requirement: Style evidence addresses outlines, shape language, shading, texture, palette, perspective, and detail density.

hardFindings.evidence: Layered architecture, restrained facially neutral forms, nuanced color transitions, detailed material treatment, and proportionate structural elements create a polished storybook-game appearance without chibi character proportions or overtly infantile styling.
